newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria stocks seen unaffected by far right surge.
newsitem.headline: Austria stocks seen unaffected by far right surge.

text.p: The triumph of the far right in Sunday's European elections in Austria was unlikely to have any noticeable impact on the Vienna bourse, traders said on Monday.
"It won't have much effect," said one, adding that the result was likely to raise eyebrows abroad.
The ATX, after breaking key support at 1,080 points on Friday, was expected to continue its upward trend through the day, supported by positive international leads, dealers said.

In the country's first elections to the European Parliament, the nationalist Freedom Party of Joerg Haider soared to its highest level in history, while the ruling Social Democrats slumped to their lowest point since Austria first embraced democracy in 1918.
Haider had campaigned on a strongly Euro-sceptic ticket, drawing on voter discontent over a stinging two-year austerity budget designed to put Austria on course for Europe's planned single currency.

But traders noted the suspected anti-Maastricht vote was unlikely to be repeated in the next national elections due in 1999. "If this was really about the government, the Freedom Party would not have done as well," said one.
